summary: Frequency Electronics Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a registered follow-on offering of $100 million of common stock. The company is offering $62.5 million of shares, while selling stockholders (Edenbrook Value Fund, LP and Edenbrook Long Only Value Fund, LP, affiliates of director Jonathan Brolin) are offering $37.5 million. The offering price is to be determined; the last sale price on July 27, 2026 was $70.64. Underwriters have a 30-day option to purchase up to $15 million additional shares from the issuer. This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
